ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 40:60 ratio of high-intensity (white) pixels concentrated in distal regions to low-intensity (black) pixels dominant in the central and proximal regions.

The central region of the fluke is a solid, low-intensity black contiguous block extending from the median notch to the peduncle interface.

localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of non-aligned, high-contrast linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) are visible across the central black region of the right lobe and crossing the white pigmentation of the left lobe distal region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive parallel rake mark scarring across the ventral surface of both lobes; localized parasitic or barnacle colonization at the fluke tips.
